name: Backup & Restore
description: Backup & Restore standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BACKUP applies.

rules.title: Define backup scope, frequency, retention and owner
rules.detail: Identify each critical datastore/configuration/artifact, recovery point objective and retention requirement.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define backup scope, frequency, retention and owner.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define backup scope, frequency, retention and owner.

rules.title: Encrypt and isolate backups
rules.detail: Protect backups in transit/at rest and prevent routine production credentials or destructive incidents from deleting all recovery copies.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Encrypt and isolate backups.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Encrypt and isolate backups.

rules.title: Test restores regularly
rules.detail: A backup is not considered reliable until representative restore procedures are executed and recovery time/data integrity are verified.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Test restores regularly.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Test restores regularly.

rules.title: Monitor backup success and age
rules.detail: Alert on failed, incomplete or stale backups and retain evidence of successful scheduled runs.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Monitor backup success and age.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Monitor backup success and age.

rules.title: Include configuration and keys needed for recovery
rules.detail: Recovery planning covers infrastructure/config/secrets metadata and rotation dependencies, not database files alone.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Include configuration and keys needed for recovery.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Include configuration and keys needed for recovery.

rules.title: Honor retention and privacy requirements
rules.detail: Expired backups containing regulated/personal data follow documented retention/deletion policy where technically and legally feasible.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Honor retention and privacy requirements.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Honor retention and privacy requirements.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BACKUP applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Backup & Restore to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Backup & Restore is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Backup & Restore failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
